title: Add tooltips to the main viewport controls

labels.name: effort:medium
labels.description: One module or crate, a known pattern (issue-worker-medium)

body:
### Where

Viewport (view, navigation, display modes)

### Kind of problem

Hard to understand or to find

### What happened, and what you expected

The main viewport has 12 icon-only controls along the bottom. These controls adjust options such as the camera view and displayed path lines, but they currently have no tooltips.

Because the icons have no text labels, it is difficult to know what each control does without hovering over it through trial and error or consulting documentation.

I expected each control to display a clear tooltip when the pointer remains over it, explaining the action it performs or the display option it changes.

### Steps to reproduce

1. Open Camcraft and load a model or operation.
2. Look at the bottom of the main viewport.
3. Hover the pointer over each of the 12 icon controls.
4. Notice that no descriptive tooltip appears.

### Screenshots or recording

_No response_

### How it should work (optional)

Each of the 12 viewport controls should have a concise, accessible tooltip that appears after a short hover delay. Tooltips should use consistent language and identify the control's action. Toggle controls should indicate the current state where useful, and the tooltips should remain readable in all supported themes.

Examples:
- “Show tool paths”
- “Solid/Wiremesh”
- “Fit view”
- “Pan”

The exact wording should match each control's actual behavior. Keyboard focus should also expose the same description if the controls support keyboard navigation.

### camcraft version, OS and screen

Camcraft 0.24
